answer: An agent economy resists Sybils by making each identity post a refundable stake before it can trade, like a garden where every plot must be bought with real seed. Creating a thousand fake agents then costs a thousand stakes, and bad behavior forfeits the deposit, so an attacker watching from a terrace cannot flood the market for free. Reputation accrues slowly per identity, line by line like a sonnet, so fresh clones start with no history to spend.
